caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a homemade toy-car ramp built from a long orange plastic loop-track taped with white strips onto a sloping wooden board. The board descends from the upper left toward the lower right, where the track continues onto the beige carpet and forms one large vertical loop resting on the floor. A series of smaller upright loops recedes up the incline along the track. No car or rolling object is seen moving along any section of the orange track. Behind the setup, a closed white door with a knob and hinge stands against tan walls above a white baseboard, while a small box fan, stacked storage bins, and a green-topped surface occupy the left background. The framing and lighting appear consistent throughout.
